scenarios.description: Straight ahead from the taxi interior on Eerikinkatu
scenarios.why: The existing Eerikinkatu taxi pose faces a street with nearby 3D roads, facades, traffic and lights.

scenarios.description: Windshield sky at cloud 0.0: clear sky: the plain gradient
scenarios.why: The Eerikinkatu taxi pose looks down an open street with sky above the facades; the sun is held near 30 degrees.

scenarios.description: Windshield sky at cloud 0.5: broken cloud patches
scenarios.why: The Eerikinkatu taxi pose looks down an open street with sky above the facades; the sun is held near 30 degrees.

scenarios.description: Windshield sky at cloud 0.9: a nearly closed cloud deck
scenarios.why: The Eerikinkatu taxi pose looks down an open street with sky above the facades; the sun is held near 30 degrees.

scenarios.description: Street view at the Oulu taxi pose from the latest F12 screenshot
scenarios.why: The captured player view shows close cars, pedestrians, signals and open sky.

scenarios.description: The taxi's and parked cars' paint under a high summer sun, buildings close on both sides
scenarios.why: Eerikinkatu, Kamppi (find: 12 lamps, 13 buildings, 4 colours within 70 x 40 m): a narrow street of 5-7 storey blocks whose walls the paint can reflect; June noon sun ~53 deg.

scenarios.description: Car paint highlights under street lamps and lit windows at night
scenarios.why: The same Eerikinkatu pose: 12 street lamps within 70 x 40 m and apartment windows on both sides; October 22:30, sun far below the horizon.

scenarios.description: Wet asphalt and puddles in rain at night, lit by street lamps and the taxi's headlights
scenarios.why: Eerikinkatu is paved city street with 12 lamps nearby; rain makes it fully wet; October 22:30.

scenarios.description: Facades of several building types and colours in daylight
scenarios.why: Lapinlahdenkatu, Kamppi (find: 14 buildings, 4 colours, 3 commercial within 70 x 40 m). OSM gives no facade materials here: colours and categories differ, materials cannot be promised.

scenarios.description: Window glass of commercial blocks reflecting the sky, overcast-free afternoon
scenarios.why: Lapinlahdenkatu has the most commercial buildings found (3) beside apartment blocks: storefront and office glazing. No mapped glass or metal facades exist in the data; this tests the window glass.

scenarios.description: Street lamps through dusk, night and dawn, then driving down the street
scenarios.why: Fabianinkatu (find: 11 street lamps within 70 x 40 m, a straight street heading south): many lamps in view; October dusk 17:30, night 22:00, dawn 07:45. Each run drives 8 s and counts lamp light reassignments.

scenarios.description: Fixed dense-city view at night for repeatable rendering measurements
scenarios.why: Eerikinkatu, Kamppi: dense blocks, 12 lamps and 13 buildings around; night so every light pool is active; the default zoom shows the most of it.

scenarios.description: The graphics settings' brightness 1.4 over a daylight street (compare with building_materials_day)
scenarios.why: The building_materials_day view (Lapinlahdenkatu: facades, park, road) with the picture settings raised: the world brighter, the HUD unchanged.

scenarios.description: A road ferry at the Vartsala landing, the taxi waiting on the slip
scenarios.why: Vartsala ferry, Kustavi (OSM route=ferry, ferry=secondary, 925 m): the taxi 8 m back from the route's east end, facing the deck of the ferry docked there (or under way, after its 40 s wait).

scenarios.description: The same ferry landing in the 2D view: the ferry drawn under the vehicles
scenarios.why: As ferry_vartsala_3d, 2D: the ferry layer is below the cars it carries.

scenarios.description: Train model view at Pasila station
scenarios.why: The Pasila station tracks are real map data; the larger area includes Helsinki Central so timetable routes can be resolved.

scenarios.description: Fast traffic on the Perämerentie motorway at 58 m/s: cars ahead of the taxi, passed and gone behind
scenarios.why: Perämerentie (Oulu): a 1.76 km straight motorway from the start pose (find, 10 km Oulu world): fast traffic should be on it ahead of the taxi and not parked on it; daylight so the motorway is visible.

scenarios.description: Windshield view on the Perämerentie motorway, driving at full throttle: traffic ahead and oncoming passes from ~70 m to ~5 m; a frame every 0.5 s
scenarios.why: Perämerentie (Oulu): the motorway_through_traffic pose, which has fast traffic ahead of the taxi and on the other carriageway (seed 1). Every car crosses the old 22 m model swap and the 60 m radius; daylight so the cars are visible.

scenarios.description: HUD weather line at cloud cover 0.1, dry
scenarios.why: The HUD weather label follows cloud cover when there is no precipitation.

scenarios.why: The HUD weather label follows cloud cover when there is no precipitation.

scenarios.description: Southbound on Merihaankatu toward Hakaniemensilta (layer-1 bridge) over a DEM hill: a sloped road and a deck above sloped ground
scenarios.why: Hakaniemensilta (OSM bridge=yes, layer=1, 170 m) starts 30 m ahead. Needs <cache>/Helsinki.dem.json: tools/make_dem.py Helsinki --test-hill 386740,6672850,10,60 (synthetic test raster) or --asc from the NLS 10 m DEM.
